name: UpLead
description: UpLead is a B2B sales intelligence platform for finding, verifying, enriching and exporting professional contact and company data, including intent and technographic signals.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned UpLead API key. Agents can read only the remaining credit count; account email, people and company data, lookup, enrichment, prospecting, preview, lists, exports and raw API access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: UPLEAD_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: UpLead API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned key from UpLead account settings. Relay encrypts it and permits only the fixed remaining-credit read.

capabilities.label: Read credit balance
capabilities.description: Read a reduced remaining-credit snapshot without returning the account email or accessing people or company data.

allowed.label: Read credit balance
allowed.description: Read only the connected UpLead account's remaining credit count without returning its email or accessing contact or company records.

blocked.label: Block people, company, and intent data
blocked.description: Person, company and combined lookup, enrichment, emails, phones, employment, education, location, social profiles, firmographics, technographics, intent and company news are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block prospecting, preview, lists, and exports
blocked.description: Prospector and Prospector Pro, Preview API, quick search, lists, CRM sync, downloads, exports, exclusions, browser extensions, batching and pagination are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block administration and raw access
blocked.description: API-key management, user and credit allocation, purchases, arbitrary endpoints, raw REST, retries, browser sessions, platform credentials and unrestricted tools are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The reduced credit-balance read runs automatically. People, company and intent data, prospecting, preview, lists, exports, administration and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same single bounded governance read runs without approval; the full-account API key never expands Relay's fixed credits request.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts exactly one parameterless remaining-credit read while Railway alone holds the customer API key.
Relay mounts exactly one parameterless remaining-credit read while Railway alone holds the customer API key.

providerSetup.blocker: An active customer UpLead account with API entitlement, an authorized user, a dedicated API key, current terms/privacy review, Railway staging entry, live credits-schema validation, disconnect rotation and post-rotation denial remain for a separate authorized provider task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized provider task must confirm API entitlement and the governance-only purpose, review current terms and privacy policy, create a dedicated key in UpLead account settings, store it in Railway staging, and validate only GET https://api.uplead.com/v2/credits. Confirm raw Authorization-header authentication, the exact reduced integer schema, 64 KiB cap, one-request/no-retry behavior, no record credit consumption, stripping of account email and unexpected fields, no people/company data, encrypted-copy deletion, provider-side rotation and post-rotation denial.

evidence.supports: UpLead documents the fixed https://api.uplead.com/v2 origin, raw Authorization API-key header, 500-request-per-minute limit, conventional errors, one GET or POST /credits response containing email and remaining credits, and broader contact, company, combined, prospector, preview and list APIs. Relay uses GET /credits only and strips email.

UpLead describes its API as verified B2B person and company enrichment, combined data and prospecting, generally charging one credit per returned contact or company. Relay blocks all data-returning and credit-consuming operations.
UpLead documents that credits unlock, export or download contact and company data. Relay exposes only the remaining-credit counter and no unlock, download or export action.

UpLead's current terms govern its hosted database and API, restrict use to authorized users and licensed purposes, impose legal and privacy duties, and specifically constrain Preview API scraping, storage and credit-circumvention. Relay blocks Preview and all profile data.

UpLead's current privacy policy describes business profiles and personal information including names, emails, phones, job titles, locations, education, experience and social handles, plus rights and opt-out controls. Relay's V1 returns none of that profile data.
